title: Plant Manager
text:
Location:

Whitsett, NC, US, 27377

Business Unit: Bison

Posting Date: Nov 19, 2026

Job Description:

As the **Plant Manager**, you will lead all aspects of plant operations with full accountability for safety, quality, delivery, inventory, and cost performance. You will drive operational excellence through disciplined execution, continuous improvement, and strong leadership while aligning plant performance with business strategy, growth objectives, and customer expectations.

This role is critical in advancing the facility as a machining and gear manufacturing center of excellence. The successful candidate will possess deep experience in precision machining operations, gear manufacturing processes, production planning, and manufacturing leadership. Equally important, this leader must create a culture of accountability, ownership, urgency, and execution where problems are solved, risks are escalated early, commitments are met, and results are consistently delivered.

You will build and develop a high-performing leadership team and create the operating discipline necessary to deliver sustainable business results.

**What you will do:**

* Lead daily plant operations to achieve safety, quality, delivery, inventory, productivity, and financial objectives.
* Own plant financial performance, including budgeting, cost control, working capital, inventory, and capital expenditures.
* Drive inventory accuracy, WIP management, MRB and E&O reduction, and effective material flow throughout the operation.
* Establish clear ownership and accountability for operational issues, including corrective actions, recovery plans, and timely resolution.
* Lead daily operating reviews to address constraints, performance gaps, recovery actions, and risks to customer commitments.
* Drive execution against production schedules, customer commitments, backlog reduction targets, and key operational metrics.
* Improve throughput, machine utilization, labor productivity, schedule attainment, and overall manufacturing efficiency.
* Champion a safety-first culture and ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and company standards.
* Drive quality performance and continuous improvement to meet or exceed customer expectations.
* Partner with supply chain, engineering, quality, finance, and commercial teams to align production plans, capacity, and resources with demand and business priorities.
* Proactively identify and escalate capacity, staffing, equipment, material, and operational risks before they impact performance or customers.
* Oversee maintenance, facilities, capital investments, and reliability initiatives to maximize equipment uptime and long-term manufacturing capability.
* Lead labor relations and employee engagement while fostering a high-performance, results-oriented work environment.
* Build and develop a strong leadership team through coaching, performance management, succession planning, and talent development.
* Represent the organization with customers, suppliers, community stakeholders, and business partners as needed.

**Leadership & Team Scope**

Lead a cross-functional team across operations, manufacturing engineering, quality, maintenance, supply chain, inventory control, finance, and human resources.

Provide leadership, coaching, development, and performance management to ensure strong execution, clear accountability, and alignment with company objectives. Responsible for establishing operational disciplines that drive ownership, problem-solving, execution, and sustainable performance improvement.

**We are looking for:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Operations Management, Supply Chain, Business, or a related technical field.
* 10+ years of progressive manufacturing leadership experience, including plant management, operations management, or value stream leadership.
* Demonstrated experience leading precision machining operations in a high-mix manufacturing environment.
* Strong hands-on manufacturing experience with CNC turning, CNC milling, grinding, gear hobbing, and related machining processes.
* Experience managing operations involving gears, splined components, shafts, and other precision-machined power transmission products.
* Proven success improving safety, quality, on-time delivery, productivity, schedule attainment, and financial performance.
* Demonstrated success reducing backlog, restoring delivery performance, and executing operational turnaround or recovery initiatives.
* Strong working knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, Continuous Improvement, Root Cause Corrective Action, and Operational Excellence methodologies.
* Demonstrated ability to build a high-accountability culture, establish clear expectations, manage performance, and drive execution through disciplined follow-up and ownership.
* Data-driven decision maker with strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities.
* Excellent communication, leadership, coaching, and stakeholder management skills.
* Demonstrated ability and willingness to use AI tools to improve productivity, decision-marking, work quality, and to reduce costs. The successful candidate must be able to identify appropriate AI use cases and critically evaluate AI-generated outputs.
* Proficiency with ERP systems, manufacturing metrics, Microsoft Excel, and Microsoft Office applications.

Preferred Qualifications:

* Previous leadership experience in gear manufacturing, power transmission, motion control, industrial drive systems, or precision mechanical component manufacturing.
* Demonstrated success transforming manufacturing operations into high-accountability, results-oriented organizations.
